hvac.name: Cool Breeze HVAC
hvac.description: Professional HVAC installation, maintenance, and repair services for residential and commercial properties. We offer AC tune-ups, furnace repair, duct cleaning, and full system installations. Appointments take 1-3 hours. We require a $75 deposit to secure your booking. Available Monday through Friday.

cleaning.name: Sparkle Pro Cleaning
cleaning.description: Residential and commercial cleaning services including standard cleaning, deep cleaning, move-in/move-out cleans, and post-construction cleanup. Sessions run 2-4 hours depending on property size. A $50 deposit is required. We work Monday through Saturday.

barber.name: The Sharp Edge Barbershop
barber.description: Premium barbershop offering haircuts, beard trims, hot towel shaves, and hair treatments for men and kids. Appointments are 30-60 minutes. No deposit required for standard cuts; $20 deposit for color treatments. Open Tuesday through Sunday.

grooming.name: Pawfect Grooming Studio
grooming.description: Full-service dog grooming including baths, haircuts, nail trims, ear cleaning, and teeth brushing. Sessions are 1-2 hours depending on breed and size. A $30 deposit is required to hold your pup's spot. Available Wednesday through Sunday.
